title: GET /api/v1/ota/manifest/{taskNo} data, RodakOS install profile
description:
This is what RodakOS accepts for installation, not everything Rodak can serve. Rodak can also return legacy manifests, external or missing URLs, and a pre-signed v2 snapshot whose original field spelling (for example an uppercase signature) passes through; RodakOS rejects those. When Rodak attaches a signature itself it requires checksumType sha256, the stored size and lowercased checksum, and 512 lowercase hex signature digits; it verifies the RSA signature only when the attachment request supplies a nonblank publicKeyPem. When serving, Rodak overwrites checksumValue and similar fields from the stored package or artifact metadata. Signed text: rodakos-ota-v2
rymcu-bigsmart
ota_0
rsa2048-sha256
<taskNo>
<version>
<fileSize>
<checksum>
. version is at most 127 UTF-8 bytes. The fileSize ceiling is the RodakOS ota_0 size.
